name: fujin-spiral-wind-sketch
description: A spiral wind shockwave projectile flying to the right, seen from the side. A white and pale sky-blue corkscrew of wind: two twisting wind ribbons spiral around a straight axis, with a bright white crescent-shaped swirling head at the front, and a tapering tail of small curved wind streaks behind. Colors only white, pale cyan, light sky blue, one darker steel blue for the edge. Crisp pixel art, no gradients, no smoke. It spins continuously while flying. Timing: 2 frames appear small, 2 frames grow to full size, hold the biggest brightest frame, 4 frame spin loop, then it unravels into thin streaks and disappears. About 12 frames.
